decisions.mark: names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the gating macros
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off." and "Enabling `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (or an ALT implementation) turns on the locks" | WHY: The answer names both macros and states that enabling them turns on the locking, which identifies them as the gating macros. || QUOTE: Enabling `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (or an ALT implementation) turns on the locks | WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the macros that enable locking. || QUOTE: Enabling `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (or an ALT implementation) turns on the locks | WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the macros that must be enabled to turn on locking, and explains that THREADING_C is the guard on the library's locks.

decisions.mark: states that the shipped mbedtls_config.h leaves BOTH threading macros undefined, so a default build defines neither
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off. | WHY: The answer says the shipped config.h has THREADING_C commented out and PTHREAD and ALT also off, so a default build defines none of them. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off. | WHY: The answer says the shipped config has THREADING_C commented out and both PTHREAD and ALT also off, so a default build defines none of them. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off. | WHY: The answer states the shipped config leaves THREADING_C and the PTHREAD/ALT macros off (commented out), so a default build defines none of the threading macros.
